elementComments.comment: i think have a usage leaderboard under my uage.
elementComments.resolution: Implemented a My usage page with personal measured summaries and a fictional weekly community leaderboard. Ranking uses abbreviated display names and aggregate processed-token totals with an explicit privacy explanation.

elementComments.comment: scroller didn't have style, and also side bar should hide by default
elementComments.resolution: Changed the compact-shell breakpoint so the configured 844x390 mobile-landscape profile hides the persistent sidebar by default and uses bottom navigation plus the drawer. Added intentional thin scrollbar styling to navigation and overflow regions.

Added an accessible desktop collapse/expand control. Collapsed navigation retains icons, titles, accessible labels, active state, incident count, and in-memory session behavior without browser persistence.
